author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Fifty-Two! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Andy Hobday has been hard at work not only creating a 2nd Edition of his popular Medieval Skirmish-to-Battle ruleset The Baron's War, but also expanding it wih a full FANTASY range of Options and a new Website in WARHOST. Nominated and selected this week by the GMG Patrons, let's jump in on this fluid minis-agnostic take on Historical and Fantastic combat.

Check out the rulebooks in digital  HERE: https://warhost.online/
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 052 -The Barons War 2E and WARHOST  by Andy Hobday
